title: Encoded input-head position
statement: Let $R$ be a number of registers, let $\Lambda$ be a label set, let $P$ be a counter program, let $x$ be an input bit string, and let $s$ be an abstract program state with read position $p$. If $p\le |x|$, then the input-head position in the machine configuration encoding $s$ is $p+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Counter program register count $R$ and label set $\Lambda$
replaced:
Let $x$ be an input bit string of length $n$ and $s$ an abstract state of a counter program over
$R$ registers whose read position $p$ satisfies $p \le n$. Then in the machine configuration
encoding $s$ on input $x$, the input head is at position $p + 1$.
